Why I Hate Private Labeling?

Private Labeling

Pros:
- It’s easy to get started
- You don’t need to think hard about it
- More creative = higher profit

Cons:
- It’s easy for someone else to copy your products
- You get more competition with the SAME product
- Manufactures may do a better job than you

The Way To Sell In Amazon:
- Create a passion product: a product that does not exists and would solve a problem
- Add value to the world. Create something unique that you’re passionate about. That way, other people will be surely passionate about it as well.

Remember: Do something that excites you!
